name: @core/ui
summary: Interface building blocks and reusable gesture choreographies for product demos.
guide:
Build an interface, then act on it by id. ELEMENTS: ui:window{title,w,h,kind:app|browser,url; slot "content"}, ui:input{placeholder,label,icon,w,h}, ui:button{text,variant}, ui:toast{text,kind,at}, ui:list-item{title,meta,value}, ui:spinner.
CHOREOGRAPHIES (in a scene's "gestures"): {"p":"ui:fill-form","field":"#email","text":"…","button":"#go"}, ui:login{email,password,button,value}, ui:search-pick{field,query,result}, ui:drag-drop{from,to}, ui:tour{a,b}. Every step gets "speed" and "at" like other gestures.
Give elements an "id" so gestures can find them; add "cursor": {"style":"arrow"} to the scene.
